text:
ana: Heads-up — saw a ~12% spike in per-token decode time for /generate-us-east at ~10:12 UTC. TTFT looks stable but kernel_ms p95 jumped. Opening thread to collect instrumentation clues.

dmitri: perf-bot alerted `redwood.token_latency.kernel_ms_p95` increase on that route. Any recent selector changes?

mei: pushed kernel_selector v2 last night. It biases toward denser microbatch packing to improve throughput. Didn’t expect impact for short-lived/long-context requests.

samir: paste the alert + did kv hit ratio change during the spike?

ana: perf-bot: "alert: route=/generate-us-east kernel_ms_p95 +12% vs baseline". Global KV hit ratio stayed ~0.86 but token-level kv_hit for tail tokens dropped to ~0.6 during the window. Prefetch latencies spiked.

dmitri: hypothesis: selector overpacked small sequences into big microbatches, increasing kernel_init amortization and shifting the KV prefetch window so late tokens missed prefetch. Our current `kernel_ms` bucket hides init vs compute.

mei: propose instrumenting split metrics:
- `redwood.token_latency.kernel_init_ms` (histogram)
- `redwood.token_latency.kernel_compute_ms` (histogram)
Tag with `kernel_variant`, `microbatch_size`, `kv_prefetch_hit`, `route`.

lisa: add `redwood.token_latency.kv_prefetch_latency_ms` and a gauge `redwood.token_latency.kv_prefetch_window_ms`. Need tag `token_index_bucket` so we can correlate tail tokens.

samir: dashboard ideas: per-route token heatmap (x = token index, y = component: prefetch/init/compute, color = p90). Filterable by kernel_variant and microbatch_size.

jordan: and a Sankey widget: tokens -> microbatch_id -> kernel_variant to surface odd packing (e.g., many short sequences in one microbatch).

ana: quick PromQL prototype (kernel_compute p95 for route):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_kernel_compute_ms_bucket{route=\"/generate-us-east\"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Join with `redwood_token_kv_hit_ratio` for correlation.

dmitri: sampling: we currently sample token attribution at 0.5% across the board. That's noisy for high-variance routes. Suggest adaptive sampling: baseline 0.5%, bump to 5-10% for routes with >5% drift from baseline. Expose `redwood.token_attrib.sampling_rate` per route.

mei: implementation notes: flag `token_attrib.adaptive_sampling=true` + durable gauge per-route. Instrumentation PR will add the histograms + tags. ETA EOD for initial metric emit to staging.

lisa: short runbook idea: if kernel_init_ms_p95 rises AND kv_prefetch_latency_ms rises AND kv_hit_ratio falls -> set selector to conservative packing or rollback v2.

samir: ops: can we backfill 48h of token_level metrics for /generate-us-east once metrics exist? Need to confirm if this behavior is new or regressed.

ana: I sampled a microbatch trace: `microbatch_id=47892` had microbatch_size=48, but most sequences were length 6-8 tokens. Overpacked. Dumping a few traces to #eng-runtime-dumps.

jordan: once metrics land I can prototype the Sankey using microbatch_id tag and microbatch_size. Will mock in dashboards repo.

ops-bot: deploy started — PR #1284 (mei) -> staging. Will report success/failure.

ana: action items: 1) emit kernel_init/kernel_compute/kv_prefetch metrics with tags (mei) — ETA EOD; 2) add adaptive sampling + per-route gauge (dmitri) — ETA 2d; 3) dashboards: heatmap + Sankey (samir/jordan) — ETA next sprint; 4) backfill 48h for /generate-us-east (ana) — after metrics land.

dmitri: also record `microbatch_packing_entropy` (simple entropy metric of sequence lengths per microbatch) to detect pathological overpacking automatically.

mei: filing PR now. tagging @ops-bot and @perf-bot for the pipeline monitors.

ana: keeping thread open for trace uploads and dashboard mocks. If you see token_index-specific kv misses, ping me with microbatch ids. :+1:
